news.title: Here's The Witcher 3 Remastered release time for your region
news.summary: The Witcher 3 Remastered is set to release on June 27th for PC, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One, 10 years after the original game's release.
news.author: Sean Martin

news.title: Fortnite's Spooky Month Kicks off With Five Nights at Freddy's Crossover
news.summary: Fortnite's Halloween special starts on October 1 with a Five Nights at Freddy's crossover, featuring a new playable character and haunted locations.
news.author: Ashely Claudino

news.title: I'm sure whoever chose to charge for WoW: Forever beta access is feeling very chuffed, given Blizzard's had to expand its server size a second time
news.summary: Blizzard has expanded its server size for WoW: Forever beta access for the second time, indicating a surge in player interest.
news.author: Harvey Randall

news.title: "We clearly handled that responsibility poorly": Paradox ban Discord profile pics of historical figures born after 1800, after bust-up with Hearts of Iron 4 players over Atatürk banning

news.title: The Mummy 4 Set Photos Reveal Rachel Weisz as Evelyn O'Connell, Suggest Time Period

news.author: Wesley Yin-Poole

news.title: As World of Warcraft: Forever's beta popularity grows, Blizzard has yet again had to increase the server cap
news.summary: Blizzard has increased server capacity for World of Warcraft: Forever's beta due to growing popularity, with a recent server cap increase reported over the weekend.

news.title: Marvel's Wolverine finally lets you turn off "fart gas" scent trails completely, but there's a catch

news.title: Castlevania's Iconic Soundtrack Gets Its Own Symphony, Brought to Life by a 25-Piece Power Rock Orchestra

news.title: 2024's Best RPG Is a Must-Play for Fire Emblem Fans
